root_cause: Canonical obligation cockpit and metrics projections existed only as service-role database views, so the operator still had to reconstruct control-plane state from GitHub/Supabase instead of consuming one safe surface.
prevention_rule: Expose one internal read-only cockpit over the existing canonical Brain views. Keep Basic Auth at the Netlify boundary, reuse the service-token Edge trust boundary, return no raw evidence payloads, and require regression plus security evaluation before canonicalization.
